recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. issue_request: FHIR-36781 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 Imaging Integration request to replace the ImagingSelection Boundaries and Relationships text and update the ImagingStudy Boundaries and Relationships text for DICOM studies, selections, Observations, DiagnosticReports, DocumentReference, and Binary.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by the June 2022 Imaging merge c138fb1b9ed930251866ab1da3be7d524b3fb1d4 / PR #2000, which changed source/imagingselection/imagingselection-introduction.xml and source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy-introduction.xml with the requested Boundaries wording.
additional_context: Later Applied/Published issues in the same section changed the exact wording: FHIR-35994 paired with FHIR-36781 on ImagingStudy subset guidance and is already audited; FHIR-47275 clarified the ImagingStudy/ImagingSelection overlap; FHIR-52064 made the Observation bullets descriptive; and FHIR-54814 added explicit ImagingSelection.derivedFrom linkage.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active source already says ImagingStudy stores details of an entire DICOM Study, ImagingSelection references a DICOM Study subset and can derive from ImagingStudy, Observation guidance distinguishes identified subsets from whole-study relationships, and DocumentReference is used for non-DICOM or rendered image content.
